messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — I'm looking into a spike in prefix-cache evictions on canary for long-context requests. Before I run a big bench, want to lock in a sampling + profiling plan so we don't waste GPU time. Any preferences on sample size and what artifacts to collect?

Samir Chen: Stratified sampling by sequence length seems best. Bins: 1-64, 65-512, 513+. 10k samples per bin should show the hit-rate curve and eviction tail. Also capture request metadata (seq_len, model, route).

Lucas Nguyen: +1. Add a KV segment-size histogram and eviction timestamps. I have a tiny tool `tools/kv_mon.py` that dumps per-worker lines like `segment_len,evict_ts,worker_id`. You can run a quick sample with:

```
# on canary box
./tools/kv_mon.py --host canary-1 --batches 10000 --out /tmp/kv-samples.jsonl
```

Olivia Park: I can run a small 2k job now to validate the pipeline and collect a flamegraph. My local wrapper:

```
./scripts/run_profile.sh --duration 120 --out /tmp/profile-olivia.svg --cmd "./bench --kv-sample 2000"
```

I'll also dump a heap snapshot and upload everything to S3.

perf-bot: Benchmark job queued: kb-bench-1762512410. Will post status updates here.

Samir Chen: When you upload, put under `s3://redwood-dev/kv/1762512345/` and include `bench-config.json` (explicit seed, bin specs). Tag objects with `eviction-investigation` and add a short readme describing the run.

Lucas Nguyen: One more experiment: run an AB with `--kv-ttl=0.5` (short TTL) vs baseline to see how eviction frequency changes. If eviction drops but hit rate also drops too much, that's a tradeoff.

Maya Patel: Plan: Olivia -> quick 2k to sanity-check collection. If outputs look sane, I'll kick off full 30k (10k per bin) and include the `--kv-ttl` AB variant. Lucas, can you add an ingestion job to pull the `segment_len` histograms into the perf dashboard (row-per-minute)? That'll help visualize eviction bursts.

Olivia Park: On it. Will paste S3 links and perf SVG when done. Expect first artifacts in ~15–20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya Patel: Perfect. Ping here when uploads are done. If anyone has a microbench or a tiny reproducer that hits the eviction path, drop it in the thread — would save iterations. Thanks! :thumbsup:
